title.name: Title
title.value: A parent’s guide to Science and Technology, Grades 1–8 (2022)

content.name: Content
content.value: describe the life cycle of a variety of animals, including insects, amphibians, birds, and mammals

content.name: Content
content.value: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

content.name: Content

content.name: Content
content.value: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials

content.name: Content

content.name: Content
content.value: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

content.name: Content
content.value: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on decomposing problems into smaller steps

content.name: Content

content.name: Content

title.name: Title

content.name: Content

content.name: Content
